summary: Antares Strategic Credit Fund II LLC filed an 8-K covering a regular and special distribution declaration, a private placement update, and NAV disclosure. The company declared a $0.1846 total net distribution payable June 29, 2026, to holders of record May 28, 2026. It continues a continuous private offering of common shares at NAV ($24.84) under Rule 506(b)/Reg S, with $0.5M in new subscriptions. The filing provides a routine business update and does not involve a transformative corporate event; it is an ordinary periodic disclosure for a BDC.
